steps.content:
Based on the two listings you linked, **there's no meaningful difference between them** — so I can't recommend one over the other.

Both are for the exact same product, the Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones in graphite:

|  | **A - Ottervale Audio** | **B - Brackmoor Sound** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days | In stock. Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| **Specs / In the box** | Identical: 40h battery, ANC + transparency, Bluetooth 5.3, USB-C, 254g, carry case / cables included | Identical |

The only difference in the listings is the seller name itself. On price, shipping, returns, warranty, rating, and product specs, they are identical.

You can buy from either one — if you have a previous account, loyalty points, or a preferred payment method with one of them, use that as your tie-breaker.
